return daily ARCH6B TargetPositions and PositionOnlyDrifts as slot results
new_flow: verify the immutable real-slot capture and SHA-256
create a distinct slot MarketDataSnapshot identity
select the four scheduled finalized daily ModelRuns and their TargetWeights

calculate PositionOnlyDrift from the new target and authoritative position snapshot
persist an append-only qualifying projection revision linked to the superseded attempt
